notes:
Inbound trial from fintech startup (self-serve sign-up). CTO (Imran) joined call 2026-02-17. Key context:
- Started with hosted API (free credits) to prototype transaction summarization + internal support assistant.
- Likes Redwood latency numbers; very cost sensitive (early stage unit economics).
- Early security asks: SOC2 checklist, SSO/SAML, KMS support. Mentioned legal will want SOC2 report before procurement.
- Curious about VPC/private deployment but prefers to start on hosted to iterate fast. Quote: "we want to move fast but need SOC2 proof for the payments team".
- Workloads: embeddings for semantic search over transaction logs (~10k docs), chat for support automation (low concurrency now), reranking for fraud flag prioritization.
- Latency/throughput targets: p95 < 200ms for chat in-app, 20-50 req/s for embeddings search during peak; fraud assistant needs <250ms tail for alerts.
- Model preference: open models or ability to pin to a stable canonical model; quantization acceptable if quality retained.
- Had an error when hitting rate limits during PoC (support ticket SUP-9876).
- Mentioned competitors being evaluated (OpenAI for speed, Anthropic for safety).
- Pricing sensitivity: expects ARR in low tens of thousands for first year, could expand with committed capacity.
